artworks.title: Female Nude Bending to the Left
artworks.medium: chalk on buff wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body drawing of a nude person sitting with one knee raised and their arms resting on it. The person is positioned in profile, facing to the right. The facial features are outlined with expressive lines, capturing the curvature of the nose and a prominent chin. The hair is depicted with loose curls. There is no visible clothing or objects present. The background is a plain, untextured light brown surface, which sets a contrast to the outlined figure.

artworks.title: Ixion
artworks.artist: Hendrik Goltzius, after Cornelis Cornelisz van Haarlem
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 33.2 x 33.5 cm (13 1/16 x 13 3/16 in.) (trimmed to plate mark)
artworks.description: This is an illustration showing a man falling through clouds and flames with a look of horror on his face. The drawing depicts a muscular figure in a state of distress, descending through voluminous clouds. The figure's contorted body and facial expression suggest turmoil. Below, there are plumes of fire and smoke adding a sense of impending doom or descent into an infernal region. The detailed line work and shading capture the chaotic motion and intense emotion of the scene, enclosed within a circular border where Latin text is inscribed.

artworks.title: Tantalus
artworks.artist: Hendrik Goltzius, after Cornelis Cornelisz van Haarlem
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 33 x 33.1 cm (13 x 13 1/16 in.) (trimmed to plate mark)

artworks.title: Judith with the Head of Holofernes
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a dramatic scene. One figure is holding something resembling a human head by the hair, while the other figure holds a sword. The primary figure is draped in fabric and adorned with accessories. The secondary figure appears muscular and is positioning the fabric. Both figures are surrounded by a circular frame with Latin text inscribed along the boundary. The drawing features detailed cross-hatching and shading to highlight the forms and the composition's tension, giving a sense of movement and depth.

artworks.title: Mars and Venus
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an intricate engraving with multiple figures in varying degrees of exposure and position. Two intertwined mostly naked figures are seated on a bed with heavy drapery around them. The central figures are a male with muscular arms wrapped around a female figure leaning back against him. Cherubic figures with wings are present, one holding the drapery above the bed and another holding a candle and drapery near the couple. The background features a scene with horses and a chariot in the sky, visible through an open window or mural. The room includes classical architectural elements, a grand bed, and on the ground rests a shield, helmet, and pelt.

artworks.title: Ulysses and Polyphemus
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from two blocks in yellow-green and black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a classical ruin scene from a slightly elevated point of view. Architectural elements are combined with natural surroundings. The horizon is placed near the middle, appearing slightly elevated due to the mountainous landscape that recedes into the distance. Hills and mountains can be seen in the background under a sky painted with soft hues of blue and occasional white clouds. Close to us, a shepherd dressed in red sits by a water's edge, accompanied by a flock of sheep. On the right, impressive ruins with tall columns and statues provide a focal point, with two figures standing on steps. The style of the painting reveals smooth brushwork, evident in the detailing of foliage and stone structures. The color palette is dominated by earth tones, browns, and greens contrasted against the serene sky.

artworks.title: Head Waiter in Café
artworks.medium: color woodcut in violet, orange, yellow and green
artworks.description: This is a painting of an interior space with stylized elements including a bust, a table, and decorative patterns. The composition includes a prominent orange background with vertical wavy lines. In the foreground, there is a table with an object that might be a book, and in the center area, a thick white column with marble-like designs supports a greenish bust sculpture. The painting's style uses bold outlines and flat areas of color. This is in style of Ernst Ludwig Kirchner.

artworks.title: Chestnut Trees in Moonlight
artworks.medium: color woodcut printed in reddish brown, blue and green
artworks.description: The image features a landscape with trees and figures. The brushstrokes are bold and expressive, using a blocky technique with distinct color contrasts. The color palette consists of earthy tones such as deep browns, blues, and greens. In the background, three silhouetted figures are depicted under trees.

artworks.title: Bathing Couple
artworks.medium: color woodcut printed in black, blue, green, and red on blotting paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of two abstract figures in a vibrant landscape. The image shows two stylized, nude figures in an abstract form against a dark blue background. The background is blue with black brushstrokes hinting at foliage. The ground is green. One figure is bending forward, while the other is seated with their back turned. The artwork features strong contrasting colors, simplified shapes, and focuses on body language. The style is reminiscent of Ernst Ludwig Kirchner, known for vivid colors, dynamic compositions, and expressive forms.

artworks.title: Women Bathing Between White Stones (Badende Frauen Zwischen Weissen Steinen)
artworks.medium: color woodcut on Japanese paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of three nude figures in a stylized landscape setting. The artwork shows three nude figures, one leaning on a large rock formation and two others standing beside a pool of water. The color palette consists of soft oranges for the figures, contrasted with teal water and stark black outlines that define the shapes and contours of the scene. Rock formations and foliage can be seen in the background, which is expressed with minimal detail and a similar color scheme of teal and black. The figures have a simplified, almost geometric appearance, emphasizing form and posture.

artworks.title: Alpine Pasture
artworks.medium: woodcut printed in black
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with rugged mountains, swirling clouds, and structures nestled among rocky terrain. The bold, expressive lines and stark black and white color palette emphasize the dramatic forms and shadows.

artworks.title: Head of Dr. Bauer
artworks.medium: color woodcut printed in black, purple, green, ochre, blue, and red-brown on japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person's head in profile view, along with another silhouette that overlaps and mirrors the head. This person is depicted from the shoulders up, facing to the right. Their facial features are stylized and prominent, with an exaggerated contour of the head and distinct lines emphasizing the features. The person has very short hair or appears bald, with distinctive black lines indicating hair texture. Their eyes are sharply outlined, with an intense blue hue. The person is wearing a dark suit jacket with a white shirt, visible above the shoulders. The background is abstract with a mix of dark shades, primarily purples and greens.

artworks.title: Bern Kunsthalle: März 33: Ernst Ludwig Kirchner: Davos
artworks.medium: color woodcut on heavy wove paper

artworks.title: Two Women (Zwei Frauen)
artworks.medium: lithograph, printed in black and pale orange inks, on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated with her arms crossed over her lap, turned slightly to her left. She has short, dark hair, distinct facial features, and a neutral expression. She appears unclothed, outlined with thick black lines against a beige background with black patterns. Another figure is partially visible to her right in an abstract, sketchy style. The composition includes orange and black hues, abstract elements, and a textured background.

artworks.title: St. Sebastian, Bound to a Tree
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper with handwritten note
artworks.description: The image shows a person hanging from a tree branch. The person is standing on their tiptoes, gripping the branch with one arm. They have a detailed facial expression with closed lips and wavy hair flowing around their face and shoulders. The person's body is muscular and partly exposed, wearing draped clothing. The background features a textured, cross-hatched pattern, particularly on the tree trunk. Various lines in the image create depth and shadow.

artworks.title: An Eastern Ruler Seated on His Throne
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on laid paper

artworks.title: Gran Alarma Escandalosa
artworks.medium: metalcut and letterpress on pink newsprint
artworks.creditLine: Given by Art Information Volunteers in Honor of Marta Madrid Horgan
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring an anthropomorphic bird with a human head conversing with a person. The style is reminiscent of Mexican broadsides. The central drawing shows an anthropomorphic bird with a human head talking to a seated figure, set against a cityscape backdrop with architectural elements. The scene is surrounded by a decorative border. The top of the page contains bold, capitalized text in Spanish, likely the headline. Below the illustration, more text is found in verse form.

artworks.title: Serafina
artworks.medium: metalcut and letterpress on yellow newsprint
artworks.creditLine: Given by Art Information Volunteers in Honor of Marta Madrid Horgan
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a Victorian-era woman with accompanying text. The artwork features an illustration of a woman in a Victorian-style dress, surrounded by decorative text in columns. The central illustration shows the woman in a detailed dress and hairstyle. The text includes the title "SERAFINA" and the subtitle "POLKA." The top border has floral elements, and the drawing is dated 1914.

artworks.title: La Mujer de Cien Maridos - Como Alfileres Prendidos
artworks.medium: metalcut on red newsprint
artworks.creditLine: Given by Art Information Volunteers in Honor of Marta Madrid Horgan
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people gathered around a central female figure. The woman is dressed in elaborate Victorian-style clothing, while six men beside her wear a variety of hats and coats typical of late 19th to early 20th-century attire. The text in Spanish above and below the drawing is surrounded by a decorative border. The upper text reads "LA MUJER DE CIEN MARIDOS COMO ALFILERES PRENDIDOS". Below the drawing, there is a poem or song in Spanish about themes of romance and coquettish behavior. The drawing features detailed linework and the text is printed against a red background. The drawing's style resembles traditional Mexican prints from the era of Posada, known for their exaggerated depictions of characters.

artworks.title: The Drawing of Lots to Divide the Promised Land
artworks.medium: black chalk on buff laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift in honor of Peter Parshall
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a group of individuals surrounding a central figure. The composition includes a large array of figures, with the central figures seated beneath a canopy or tent. Surrounding them are more standing figures in flowing garments, one of whom is interacting with a large vessel or urn. The scene features elements like trees in the background. The artwork is done in a classical style, capturing a sense of narrative and interaction between the figures.

artworks.title: Grayling Fishing
artworks.medium: mezzotint in brown-black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a river scene with a low horizon and trees on either side, creating a natural border. The artist used soft, blurred brushstrokes and chiaroscuro to give the image texture. The color palette is warm sepia. In the water, a figure is fishing, surrounded by reeds and a tree.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Catherine
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval scene. In the foreground, there are figures by a body of water. A character is holding a sword near another figure's neck. There are other figures in robes or gowns around them. The background shows a hilly landscape with a castle and horsemen. Above are angels or mythical creatures among the clouds, with rays of light streaming down.

artworks.title: Paris: Vue prise du pont d'Austerlitz (Paris: View Taken from the Pont d'Austerlitz)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene with a cityscape in the distance. The horizon aligns with trees and city architecture. A cathedral or church with spires is prominent. The style is detailed etching or engraving. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of gray and sepia. Large boats are moored by the riverbank, with figures nearby suggesting activity. In the distance, there are more structures and a bridge. The sky has soft clouds.

artworks.title: The Water Mill
artworks.artist: Jean-Jacques de Boissieu, after Jacob van Ruisdael
artworks.medium: etching on chine collé
